prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a rear-end collision claim. Injury: back strain. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1464; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following report of a rear-end collision at a signalized intersection. Insured vehicle was stopped at the light when struck from behind by a third-party vehicle. Police report requested. Both vehicles reported drivable from the scene. Insured reports no airbag deployment.

Entry 2: Third-party driver's carrier acknowledged liability coverage and assigned its own adjuster. Photos of both vehicles received from insured. Rear bumper damage on insured vehicle appears consistent with the reported impact. Repair estimate requested from preferred shop.

Entry 3: Claimant has retained counsel. Representation letter received and noted in file. All further contact to be routed through counsel. Claimant reports neck and lower back discomfort with ongoing treatment at a local clinic. Medical authorization requested through counsel.

Entry 4: Counsel's office provided initial treatment records indicating a diagnosis of lumbar strain. Treating provider recommends physical therapy and follow-up in four weeks. Records reviewed and logged. Bodily injury reserve reviewed and adjusted pending further documentation of treatment and related costs.

Entry 5: Vehicle repair estimate finalized and approved. Rental coverage confirmed for the repair period. Counsel's office notified that the injury claim remains open pending the treating physician's final report and receipt of itemized billing. File diary set for follow-up in thirty days.
